newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-LIAM BOTHAM SCORES TRY IN FIRST MATCH FOR HARTLEPOOL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LIAM BOTHAM SCORES TRY IN FIRST MATCH FOR HARTLEPOOL.

text.p: Liam Botham, who made a dramatic first class cricket debut this year, scored a try two minutes from time on Saturday in his first rugby match for Hartlepool.
Botham, 19, son of England's greatest all-round cricketer Ian, came on as a replacement at centre in the 53rd minute and scored a try in the 37-25 win in a friendly against Watsonians.
In his county debut for Hampshire against Middlesex this year, Botham dismissed former England captain Mike Gatting with his seventh delivery and went on to take five for 67.
